description: For a finitely satisfiable theory \(\Gamma\) on atoms indexed by \(\mathbb N\), there is a valuation \(v:\mathbb N\to\{0,1\}\) whose restriction to every initial segment is a surviving assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.prefix_branch_exists
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory ℕ)
  (hfin : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.FiniteSatisfiable Γ) :
  ∃ v, ∀ (n : ℕ), Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.PrefixSurvives Γ n fun i => v ↑i
